summary: South Wales Police used automated facial recognition at the 2017 Champions League final in Cardiff, and about 92% of its matches were wrong. Police said no one was wrongly arrested.
technical_summary: Live facial recognition compared faces in a crowd of about 170,000 with custody images. Of 2,470 alerts, 2,297 were false positives. Police attributed this to poor-quality watch-list images and the technology's first major use.

summary: Doctors in Hyderabad reported two patients harmed after following ChatGPT medical advice. A kidney transplant recipient stopped her medication and lost the graft, and a man with diabetes developed dangerously low sodium after cutting out salt.

Patients acted without consulting clinicians, leading to graft failure and severe hyponatremia.
